name: Nicotinyl alcohol hydrofluoride
description: Nicotinyl alcohol hydrofluoride (CAS 62756-44-9 ), also known as Fluorinol and nicomethanol fluorhydrate, is a fluoride salt of nicotinyl alcohol used as a specialty reagent and active pharmaceutical ingredient intermediate. It functions primarily as a pH regulator and buffering agent in pharmaceutical and biotechnology formulations where controlled fluoride delivery is required. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it serves as a precursor or reference standard. This compound is essential in the synthesis of nicotinic acid derivatives and fluoride-containing drug candidates. Biotechnology and life sciences laboratories source it as an analytical reagent for assay development and compound screening workflows. Its buffering capacity makes it suitable for use in formulation research where precise pH control influences active ingredient stability. Contract research organizations and API manufacturers also use it as a building block. The material is frequently utilized in heterocyclic compound synthesis programs. Nicotinyl alcohol hydrofluoride is typically supplied as a crystalline solid or powder to ensure ease of handling in laboratory settings. It is available in pharmaceutical-grade and research-grade specifications to meet the purity requirements of API development and analytical applications. These standards ensure consistency across various manufacturing processes. Pack sizes generally range from small laboratory quantities through to bulk orders for process-scale pharmaceutical synthesis.
